purpose: Search every state reachable from the empty graph under every tied minimum-loss look-ahead action, and seek a reachable action that destroys exact balanced-completion feasibility.
method: Labeled graph states are deduplicated by edge bitmask. Breadth-first traversal explores all actions tied for the smallest one-step legal-action loss. Each reached state is checked for balanced optimum feasibility. A failure witness is independently checked by enumerating all balanced bipartitions.
interpretation: A witnessed loss is a counterexample for the specified tie-breaking support. Complete finite sizes without a witness are finite checks, not an arbitrary-size guarantee. If the state cap is reached, the size is explicitly marked incomplete.
